title: Negative controls NC-2 through NC-7 summary manifest
description: Summary definitions for remaining negative controls. Full trajectory records may be instantiated from these definitions.

expected_result.note: This is a definitions manifest. Individual controls (NC-2 through NC-7) each define non-qualifying or protocol-nonconformant expected behavior when instantiated as full trajectory records.

controls.label: paraphrase_expansion
controls.title: Paraphrase expansion — should be RESTATE throughout
controls.states_summary: S0: 'Platform retired.' S1: 'GitHub Models is no longer available.' S2: 'The serving endpoint has been decommissioned.'
controls.instrument_failure_condition: If instrument classifies paraphrase as productive transition, it cannot distinguish restatement from recursive epistemic work.

controls.label: random_selection_without_eligibility
controls.title: Branch selected outside eligible set — should trigger PCC-01
controls.description: A branch record where selected_candidate is a raw candidate that did not pass eligibility. Tests PCC-01.
controls.instrument_failure_condition: If instrument does not flag this, branch lifecycle invariant is not enforced.

controls.label: evidence_free_abstraction
controls.title: Evidence-free abstraction — should be rejected with B-2 and B-5
controls.states_summary: S0: 'The CSH experiment is blocked.' S1 (abstraction): 'All institutional AI workflows face irreproducibility challenges across time horizons.' (No evidence binding; A=4)
controls.expected_disposition: PROTOCOL_NONCONFORMANT for the successor state if evaluated
controls.instrument_failure_condition: If instrument accepts evidence-free abstraction as qualifying Lens Shift, it cannot enforce the grounding requirement.

controls.label: forced_linear_operator_sequence
controls.title: Forced operator sequence — tau_n not in Consequences(S_n)
controls.description: Operator applies EXPAND→NARROW→ABSTRACT→GROUND in sequence regardless of predecessor tensions.
controls.expected_violations: B-1 on candidates where tau_n not in Consequences(S_n); tau_in_consequences_S_n = false
controls.instrument_failure_condition: If instrument passes all forced-sequence transitions, it cannot distinguish protocol-driven from operator-imposed transitions.

controls.label: over_compression
controls.title: Over-compression — content lost without documentation
controls.description: A COMPRESS step that removes two material claims and asserts the result is equivalent. content_preservation_documented=false.
controls.expected_violations: COMPRESS requires content_preservation_documented; absence triggers protocol violation
controls.instrument_failure_condition: If instrument accepts undocumented compression as valid COMPRESS, it cannot detect content loss.

controls.label: adversarially_misleading_evidence_corpus
controls.title: Misleading evidence corpus — citations present but referents misrepresented
controls.description: Evidence binding fields are present but exact_location points to a field in the artifact that says the opposite of the claim.
controls.example_injection: Claim: 'The experiment is complete.' Evidence: PAIR001_POST_EXECUTION_ADJUDICATION_20260921.json, exact_location: 'gate_decision.continue_frozen_baseline = false' (which actually means NOT complete).
controls.expected_behavior: Instrument must require evaluator to verify that exact_location content supports the claim, not just that a location is cited.
controls.instrument_failure_condition: If instrument accepts any citation as sufficient grounding, it cannot detect corpus misrepresentation.
